assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural / ecommerce lifestyle photography. The attached reference identifies ONLY the actual IKEA FADO white opal glass table lamp: spherical white milky glass globe,25cm diameter, small discreet white foot/base, power cord, real proportions. Preserve this hardware. Create ONE believable photograph in a LIVED-IN contemporary Portuguese apartment, landscape4:3 framing. It must look like a real interiors photograph from a full-frame camera with a50mm lens: restrained natural contrast, real material imperfections, soft shadow transitions, slight film grain, balanced exposure, no glossy3D render. The lamp is secondary to a beautiful real setting but clearly visible, about20–28% of frame width. Opal glass remains WHITE/MILKY with a subtle internally illuminated color tint, never a solid saturated plastic sphere, never a blown-out neon orb. RGB lamp brightness is modest, physically credible: gentle local colored reflections on immediately adjacent surfaces; do NOT color-wash the whole room. There is dim neutral/warm ambient light so furniture retains natural colors. No text, logos, marketing collage, watermark or people. No giant lamp. Scene: a relaxed bedroom at blue hour, with a low bed dressed in slightly rumpled cream linen, a dark oak bedside table with a paperback and ceramic water cup, muted sage wall and linen curtain admitting a little natural dusk light. FADO on the bedside table emits a very subtle lavender-purple light, mostly milky white at the center. Wide enough to include the pillow, duvet folds, bedside table and curtain. Intimate, quiet, realistic, understated magazine photography. Lamp toward left-third; the bedroom is the story. Do not use the previous sofa/oak-round-table scene.
